name: @verdikt/cre
comment: verify/ and aggregate/ file:-link this directory rather than cre/ itself (its parent): cre/ contains cre/workflows/verify, which is where the link gets installed, and bun's file: copy has no self-containment guard — file:../.. recurses into its own just-written output until the OS path-length limit stops it. lib/ has no such descendant, so the link terminates.
